ValidationRule.description: Created from JIRA ticket: BOPI-231. BOPI-526 Fixed. Was set to trigger when status equals approved, see the original formula: AND( SBQQ__Ordered__c == True , (ISPICKVAL(SBQQ__Status__c ,"Client Approved"))) BOPI-581 ByPass added to skip validations
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( SBQQ__Ordered__c == True, NOT(ISPICKVAL(SBQQ__Status__c ,"Client_Approved")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(SBQQ__Opportunity2__r.Type, "Auto Renewal")) ) && Quote_Val_Bypass__c = false
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The quote status must be 'Client Approved' before ordering
